BANK_FEE.say: We absorb receiving-bank wire fees up to $50. Not worth a customer conversation.
BANK_FEE.say_else: Over $50 is not a bank fee we eat. Leave it open and chase.

DISCOUNT_TAKEN.say_else: Over $25, or a third time in a quarter: leave it open and chase.

DUPLICATE_PAYMENT.say: Hold duplicate payments as customer credit.

PREPAID_CREDITS.say: Prepaid credits are deferred revenue until used.
